description: Put races from search_races on the user's Goal Race list, the same list the hearts on the site write to, with status 'wishlist'. Pass each race's url exactly as search_races returned it; up to 20 at once. A race already on the list (same name and day) comes back in already_on_list, not duplicated. A race search_races does not list goes in with add_custom_race. Requires signing in.

format.description: Wave or distance the user picked, e.g. 'Sprint 5K'. Omit when they did not say.

name: save_race
title: Save races to the list
